column3: Pixel pet just got a big update. Here's what's new.
It now lives in a little world that follows your day, and scrolls by while Claude works.
Narration is calmer. One line when the work changes, and a quiet summary in long turns.
It cheers when your tests pass, and groans when they fail.
When Claude needs your OK, it waves you over, with an optional chirp.
It notes, calmly, when your plan limits get close.
It dresses up for the seasons.
Share a card of your pet in its world.
And it's one pet everywhere, with the same name in every session.
Make it yours, with calm mode, break reminders, and more.
Update pixel pet today. It's free, on GitHub.
